values.title: Terminal muon magnetic-anomaly empirical prediction
values.statement: Observation informed the explicit terminal muon law.  The measurement target is then placed behind the capability boundary while the engine completely enumerates, uniquely selects and seals the exact prediction; the complete authoritative interval is released only afterward.
values.generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis post-seal terminal muon anomaly comparison product.
values.grammar_boundary: The complete registered Fermilab world-average muon anomaly row, exact central value and complete standard uncertainty, together with the sealed target-inaccessible Fold prediction and preserved provenance.
values.exact_result: The exact terminal muon anomaly sealed without target access lies inside the complete registered Fermilab world-average standard-uncertainty interval.
values.induction_base: The source row retains its exact central value, complete standard uncertainty and immutable sealed prediction.
values.induction_step: Every future source revision forms a new registered comparison and cannot rewrite this seal or its provenance.
exclusions: no measurement target in the executable relation
no measured value selecting a formal survivor
no fitted coefficient or uncertainty enlargement
target_rows: complete Fermilab world-average central value and standard uncertainty
values.falsification_condition: The exact sealed muon prediction leaves the complete registered interval, the target becomes readable before sealing, a measured value selects the survivor, an uncertainty changes, or observational provenance is hidden.
